summary.text: Pat Stefano is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 32 since his election in November 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He chairs the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure Committee.

paragraphs.text: Pat Stefano lives in Fayette County and was a third-generation owner of his family's business, Stefano's Printing, where he worked from the early 1980s until it closed during the pandemic, according to his official biography.
He is a past president of the Fayette County Chamber of Commerce and has served on the board of the Fay-Penn Economic Development Council.
He is a lifetime member and former board president of the American Heart Association, where he has volunteered for more than 30 years.
Stefano chairs the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure Committee and is vice chair of the State Government Committee.
He also serves on the Aging and Youth; Community, Economic and Recreational Development; Health and Human Services; Rules and Executive Nominations; and Transportation committees.
His biography says that, coming from a family of teachers, he has pledged to focus on students and the classroom.
